Challenges That Organizations Face When Using Video and Rich Media
How Kaltura Addresses Organizations' Video and Rich Media Challenges
paragraphs: We, Kaltura, Inc. ("Kaltura," "we," "us," or "our"), are a market-leading provider of video and rich media offerings for enterprises. Our mission is to power rich, agentic digital experiences across organizational journeys for customers, employees, learners, and audiences.

Kaltura's Digital Experience Platform enables organizations to create, manage, and deliver video and rich media experiences that increasingly incorporate agentic artificial intelligence ("AI") capabilities, including conversational interfaces, workflow automation, and outcome-oriented engagement across digital touchpoints. We believe this combination of video, rich media and agentic capabilities enables organizations to move beyond static, one-size-fits-all digital experiences toward more personalized, contextual, and interactive agentic digital experiences at scale.

Video and other forms of rich media - including interactive, data-driven, and conversational media - are central to digital interaction and engagement, transforming how people communicate, work, learn, and consume content. For organizations, rich media increasingly sits at the core of digital transformation initiatives, with businesses adopting media-driven solutions to engage customers, employees, learners, and audiences across a growing range of use cases. At the same time, advances in generative artificial intelligence ("Gen AI") are enabling the real-time and automated creation of highly personalized and contextually relevant content, including video and other forms of rich media. We believe the convergence of rich media and AI is increasing the scale, speed, and strategic importance of digital experiences and driving demand for platforms that support more interactive, contextual, and outcome-oriented engagement.

Founded in 2006, Kaltura was among the pioneers to recognize the potential of integrating video into enterprise workflows and to offer a system for enterprise video content management and online video publishing. Over time, we expanded our platform to support additional experiences, including virtual events and webinars and cloud-based television services. Today, Kaltura provides a cloud-based rich media platform designed to help organizations create, manage, and deliver rich media experiences at scale across customer-facing, employee-facing, learner-facing, and audience-facing use cases.

Our Digital Experience platform is designed around three core layers: rich media content creation, rich media content management, and rich media experiences. Together, these layers enable organizations to produce and generate live and on-demand video and other forms of rich media, securely manage content, users, permissions, and metadata across enterprise and media environments, and deliver media-rich experiences across a wide range of internal and external workflows. The platform increasingly incorporates agentic AI-driven capabilities designed to enable more interactive, contextual, and goal-oriented experiences, while maintaining enterprise-grade security, privacy, and governance.

In addition, through our recent acquisition of eSelf AI, we expanded our content creation and experience capabilities to include AI-generated video and avatar-based interactions. These capabilities enhance our rich media content creation layer through tools for generating video and avatar-based content and extend our experience layer with conversational, role-based interfaces designed to automate and augment interactions across select customer- and employee-facing use cases. Since the acquisition, we have focused on integrating these capabilities into our platform in a manner consistent with enterprise requirements for security, compliance, and responsible AI use.

Our platform and products engage millions of end users at home, at work, and at school, supporting rich media experiences across marketing, sales, and customer success; teaching, learning, training, and certification; communication and collaboration; and entertainment and monetization. We serve a large and loyal customer base of large enterprises as well as small and medium enterprises ("SMEs") across diverse industries, including customers representing approximately 30% of Fortune 100 companies, more than 40% of US R1 universities (in 2025 the Carnegie classification methodology changed which resulted in 41 new institutions added to the list), and leading global telecommunications and media companies.

From the outset, our differentiated approach has been to treat video and rich media as data types rather than standalone applications. Accordingly, we provide a unified, enterprise-grade, API-first platform that enables tightly integrated live, real-time, and on-demand video and rich media experiences across business workflows. We believe this approach has become increasingly important in the age of artificial intelligence, as it positions customers to be "AI-ready" by making their rich media libraries, metadata, and engagement data accessible for analysis, automation, and value extraction across AI-assisted and agentic use cases.

We believe platform-based approaches such as ours are superior to siloed point solutions that lack deep integration and interoperability and are often less effective, less efficient, and more costly. Our platform is designed to foster deeper engagement and deliver measurable business outcomes across organizational journeys, including improving employee productivity and learning outcomes, increasing marketing effectiveness and customer engagement, enhancing customer care, and enabling engaging entertainment experiences that support monetization.

We believe the enterprise video and rich media market is entering a new phase of evolution driven by advances in Gen AI. These advances enable organizations to produce significantly more content, tailor experiences to individual users and contexts, and increasingly automate interactions at scale. As a result, we believe organizations are seeking platforms that can unify content creation, management, and delivery with guided, conversational, and outcome-oriented engagement, supported by deeper insights into user behavior, context, and intent.

As we look ahead, we see opportunities to deepen relationships with existing customers through additional upsell and cross-sell initiatives, attract new customers within our existing markets, expand our product and services portfolio, and selectively pursue adjacent market opportunities. We believe this combination of continued innovation, platform extensibility, and strong customer relationships positions us to maintain leadership in the evolving video and rich media market and deliver long-term value for our shareholders.

We operate in four enterprise software market segments that address the creation, management, and delivery of video and rich media experiences across customer-facing, employee-facing, learner-facing, and audience-facing use cases. Over time, our offerings have expanded beyond core enterprise video use cases to support a broader range of rich media, AI-assisted, and conversational engagement needs. We currently operate in the following commercial market segments:

This market segment includes systems designed to enable organizations to create, generate, manage, analyze, distribute, publish, and engage with live, real-time, and on-demand video and other forms of rich media at scale. These systems are built to support enterprise-grade requirements for security, compliance, governance, scalability, and deep integration with business workflows and systems.

Offerings in this segment typically include rich media content creation tools, AI-assisted and AI-generated content capabilities, content enrichment and repurposing, centralized content management, publishing, analytics, and content lifecycle management. These systems increasingly incorporate AI-driven capabilities to automate and enhance content creation, localization, accessibility, personalization, and engagement, while supporting secure operations across distributed teams and environments.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry
We have a history of losses and may not be able to achieve or maintain profitability.
Our results of operations are likely to fluctuate from quarter to quarter and year to year, which could adversely affect the trading price of our common stock.
We may face risks associated with our use of certain AI and machine learning model technologies and compliance with the evolving regulatory framework around AI development and use.
The failure to effectively develop and expand our marketing and sales capabilities could harm our ability to increase our customer base and achieve broader market acceptance of our offerings.
The sales prices of our offerings may change, which may reduce our revenue and gross profit and adversely affect our financial results.
paragraphs: Our business involves a high degree of risk. You should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below, together with all of the other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. The occurrence of any of the events described below could harm our business, operating results, financial condition, liquidity, or prospects. In any such event, the market price of our common stock could decline, and you may lose all or part of your investment. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us, or that we currently deem immaterial, may also impair our business. See "Forward-Looking Statements."

We may not be able to successfully assess or mitigate the current volatile economic climate and its direct and indirect impact on our business and operations, including our customers and vendors, or to correctly predict the duration and depth of the current instability of the global economy and take the right or sufficient measures to address it, and as a result our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects would be adversely affected.

The nature of our activities and our global presence and operations expose us to global and local macro and micro effects, including the effects of global economic trends such as the current global economic volatility, rising inflation, unpredictable interest rates, price increases, armed conflicts in various regions including the Middle East and Eastern Europe, political changes and their impact on the economic markets, decrease in our customers' spend or available budget that causes decline in demand, up-sales or subscription renewals, and other adverse effects that might have direct or indirect effects on our business and results of operations that are hard to predict, monitor or assess. Such developments have caused and may continue to cause uncertainties and high volatility with respect to our estimated or expected results of operations, may develop differently from our estimations and expectations, and could have an adverse effect on our business, results of operations and financial condition.

In addition, the current economic climate has resulted in, among other things, longer sale cycles and increased price driven competition, including through initiation of bid processes, which has adversely affected our ability to retain our existing customers and our ability to generate renewals and up-sales. We expect these trends to continue in the near-term. If we are unable to retain our existing customer base or to obtain new customers at reasonable prices, our revenue could be eroded or might even decline, and as a result our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects will be adversely affected.

Our dependency on existing customers' demand and exposure to change in demand by our customers, including due to reasons not under our control, makes it difficult to evaluate our current business and future prospects and may increase the risk that we will not be successful.

As video usage continues to accelerate across communication, work, and learning environments, organizations are increasingly deploying sophisticated video solutions to further engage with their customers, partners, and employees. The introduction of generative AI ("Gen AI") further amplifies this demand and is expected to have a substantial impact on our business by enabling the automatic production of hyper-personalized and contextually relevant video experiences in real time. We believe this powerful new tool will expand opportunities for increased video creation, consumption, and monetization, and drives a need for advanced video content management solutions.

To support our AI capabilities, in 2025, we acquired eSelf AI, a multimodal AI lab developing technology for agentic interactions with live avatars. Through this acquisition, we expanded our content creation and experience capabilities to include AI-generated video and avatar-based interactions, enhancing our rich media content creation layer. In addition, in March, 2026, we entered into a definitive agreement to acquire PathFactory, a provider of content journey orchestration and engagement analytics solutions. We believe this acquisition, once completed, would strengthen our position in the emerging conversation automation and agentic engagement solutions market and complement our recent acquisition of eSelf AI by adding journey-level orchestration, intent data, analytics, and integrations across additional content types and enterprise systems. The transaction has not yet closed, and there can be no assurance that it will be completed or that the anticipated benefits will be realized.

We generate revenue primarily from the sale of Software-as-a-Service ("SaaS") subscriptions, and we also derive revenue from platform usage license subscriptions and associated professional services. Our sales typically target medium to large enterprises, educational institutions, technology providers, and media and telecom companies. In addition, we are expanding our go-to-market approaches to support a wider range of adoption models and customer sizes. Our professional services revenue is generally driven by implementation and support services for new and existing customers.

In August 2025, our Board of Directors approved a reorganization plan (the "2025 Reorganization Plan) that included, among other things, downsizing approximately 10% of our workforce and adapting our organizational structure, roles, and responsibilities accordingly. The total cost reduction from the downsizing in connection with the 2025 Reorganization Plan on an annualized basis is expected to be approximately $8.5 million. The 2025 Reorganization Plan, which was completed in the third quarter of 2025, is focused on realigning the Company's operations to further increase efficiency and productivity, alongside our integration of enhanced AI-based technologies, to align the Company's business strategy in light of uncertainties in the current macro-economic climate, and to support the Company's growth and profitability initiatives.

We organize our business into two reporting segments: (i) Enterprise, Education, and Technology ("EE&T"); and (ii) Media and Telecom ("M&T"). Accordingly, our financial reporting distinguishes between revenue and gross profit from Subscription and Professional Services from customers who use our products and services to address Entertainment & Monetization use cases (for their audiences), reported in our M&T segment, and those that are attained from customers who are using us to address all other use cases (for their customers, employees, and learners), reported in our EE&T segment. These segments share a common underlying platform consisting of our API-based architecture, as well as unified product development, operations, and administrative resources.

•Enterprise, Education & Technology: In the EE&T segment, subscription revenue is primarily generated on a per full‑time equivalent or platform usage‑license basis for all of our products, in addition to revenue derived from associated professional services. This segment encompasses customers utilizing Kaltura's solutions to deliver agentic rich-media experiences for their customers, employees, and learners such as buyer enablement, employee recruiting, learning and teaching. Contracts in this segment typically range from 12 to 24 months, with billing generally executed on an annual basis.

•Media & Telecom: The M&T segment includes revenue from customers using Kaltura to deliver entertainment and streaming use cases to their audiences, along with the associated professional services. For customers of our telecom TVCMS and TV Streaming Applications, revenue is recognized primarily on a per end‑subscriber basis, while media customers leveraging our Online Video Platform are billed on a platform usage‑license basis. Contracts in this segment generally extend for two to five years, with billing performed on either a quarterly or annual basis. Implementation of TV offerings typically requires six to 12 months, with upfront resource requirements generally higher than those for our other offerings. Consequently, there is an extended period from initial booking to go‑live, accompanied by a higher proportion of professional services revenue relative to overall revenue. Additionally, a greater share of revenue in this segment is derived from customers licensing our offerings through private cloud and on‑premise deployments, which has an impact on our gross margin.

paragraphs: 我們，Kaltura, Inc.（"Kaltura," "we," "us," 或 "our"），是企業提供影片及多媒體服務的市場領導者。我們的使命是為客戶、員工、學習者及觀眾，提供跨組織旅程的豐富、自主的數位體驗。
Kaltura 的數位體驗平台，使組織能夠建立、管理並交付影片及多媒體體驗，這些體驗越來越整合自主性人工智慧（"AI"）功能，包括對話介面、工作流程自動化，以及在數位接觸點的目標導向參與。我們相信，這種結合影片、多媒體與自主性功能的組合，使組織能從靜態、一刀切的數位體驗，轉向更大規模、更個人化、更情境化與互動性的自主數位體驗。

影片及其他形式的多媒體，包括互動式、資料驅動及對話式多媒體，是數位互動與參與的核心，改變人們溝通、工作、學習及消費內容的方式。對組織而言，多媒體越來越成為數位轉型計畫的核心，企業採用以多媒體為主的解決方案，以在日益廣泛的使用案例中，與客戶、員工、學習者及觀眾互動。同時，生成式人工智慧（"Gen AI"）的進步，使能即時且自動化地創造高度個人化及情境相關的內容，包括影片及其他形式的多媒體。我們相信，多媒體與人工智慧的結合，正在增加數位體驗的規模、速度與戰略重要性，並推動對支持更互動、情境化與目標導向參與的平台的需求。
Kaltura 於 2006 年成立，是首批認知將影片整合至企業作業流程潛力的先驅之一，並提供企業影片內容管理與線上影片發佈系統。隨時間推移，我們擴展了平台，以支援更多體驗，包括虛擬活動與研討會，以及雲端電視服務。目前，Kaltura 提供一個雲端多媒體平台，協助組織在面對客戶、員工、學習者及觀眾的使用案例中，大規模建立、管理並交付多媒體體驗。
我們的數位體驗平台設計為三個核心層：多媒體內容創作、多媒體內容管理及多媒體體驗。這些層次使組織能產生並生成即時與點播影片及其他形式的多媒體，安全地管理內容、使用者、權限與元資料，並在企業與媒體環境中，交付廣泛的內部與外部作業流程的多媒體體驗。此平台越來越整合自主性 AI 驅動的功能，以實現更互動、情境化與目標導向的體驗，同時維持企業等級的安全性、隱私權與治理。
此外，透過我們最近收購 eSelf AI，我們擴展了內容創作與體驗能力，以包含 AI 生成的影片與基於虛擬形象的互動。這些能力透過生成影片與虛擬形象內容的工具，增強我們的多媒體內容創作層，並透過對話式、角色導向的介面，擴展我們的體驗層，以自動化並增強在特定客戶與員工面對的使用案例中的互動。自收購以來，我們專注於以符合企業對安全性、合規性與負責任 AI 使用的要求，將這些能力整合至我們的平台中。

我們的平台與產品，服務數百萬終端使用者，在家中、工作中及學校中，支援多媒體體驗，包括行銷、銷售與客戶成功；教學、學習、培訓與認證；溝通與協作；以及娛樂與商業化。我們服務的客戶羣包括大型企業以及中小企業（"SMEs"）在多樣產業，包括代表約 30% 的《財富》百大企業的客戶，超過 40% 的美國 R1 大學（2025 年卡內基分類方法變更，導致新增 41 所機構至名單中），以及領先的全球電信與媒體公司。
從一開始，我們的差異化方法是將影片與多媒體視為資料類型，而非獨立應用程式。因此，我們提供一個統一、企業等級、以 API 為先的平台，使企業作業流程中能緊密整合即時、實時與點播的影片與多媒體體驗。我們相信，這種方法在人工智慧時代變得越來越重要，因為它使客戶能成為 "AI 就緒"，透過讓其多媒體圖書館、元資料與參與資料可供分析、自動化與價值提取，以支援 AI 協助與自主性使用案例。
我們認為基於平台的解決方案，例如我們的方案，優於缺乏深度整合與互通性且通常較不有效、較不高效且成本更高的孤島式點對點解決方案。我們的平台設計用以促進更深入的參與，並在組織的各個旅程中實現可衡量的業務成果，包括提高員工生產力和學習成果、增加行銷效果與客戶參與、提升客戶服務，以及提供支持 monetization 的 engaging 娛樂體驗。
我們認為企業視訊與富媒體市場正進入由 Gen AI 技術進步驅動的新一階段演化。這些進步使組織能夠產生顯著更多內容、針對個別用戶與情境進行客製化，並在更大規模上自動化互動。因此，我們認為組織正在尋求能夠統合內容創作、管理與交付，並透過引導式、對話式與以成果為導向的參與方式，提供更深入的用戶行為、情境與意圖洞察的平台。
展望未來，我們看到有機會透過額外的 upsell 與 cross-sell 計畫深化與現有客戶的關係，吸引新客戶至我們現有市場，擴展我們的產品與服務組合，並選擇性地追求相關市場的機會。我們認為這組合持續創新、平台延展性與強大客戶關係，使我們能維持在演進中的視訊與富媒體市場的領導地位，並為股東創造長期價值。
我們運作於四個企業軟體市場分部，這些分部針對客戶面對、員工面對、學習者面對與觀眾面對的使用情境，處理視訊與富媒體體驗的創作、管理與交付。隨著時間推移，我們的產品已擴展至核心企業視訊使用情境之外，以支援更廣泛的富媒體、AI 協助與對話式參與需求。我們目前運作於以下商業市場分部：
此市場分部包含用以使組織能夠大規模創作、產生、管理、分析、分發、發佈與參與直播、即時與點播視訊及其他形式富媒體的系統。這些系統建構於企業等級的保安、合規、治理、可擴展性與與業務作業流程與系統深度整合的要件。
此分部的產品通常包括富媒體內容創作工具、AI 協助與 AI 產生內容能力、內容增強與重新利用、集中式內容管理、發佈、分析與內容生命週期管理。這些系統越來越 incorporates AI 驅動的能力，以自動化與增強內容創作、本地化、可存取性、客製化與參與，同時支援於分散團隊與環境中的安全作業。

paragraphs: 以下對我們財務狀況及營運成果的討論與分析，應與本年度報表上所附之合併財務報表及相關附註一併閱讀。此討論包含基於目前計畫、預期與信念之向前看陳述，涉及風險與不確定性。我們實際結果可能與此向前看陳述中預期的有重大差異，原因包括其他因素，如 Part I, Item 1A, "Risk Factors" 所列舉者，及其他部分此年度報表上所列舉者。

本年度報表上此部分討論我們財務狀況及營運成果於財務年度終了為 2025 年 12 月 31 日及 2024 年 12 月 31 日，並比較 2025 財務年度與 2024 財務年度之年對年資料。有關 2023 財務年度終了之財務狀況及營運成果，以及比較 2024 財務年度與 2023 財務年度之年對年資料，可參閱我們於 2025 年 2 月 20 日提交之 2024 財務年度年度報表上 Form 10-K 所附之 "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" 部分。
我們，Kaltura, Inc.（"Kaltura"、"我們"、"我們公司" 或 "我們的"），為企業提供視訊與豐富媒體服務之市場領導者。我們的使命為協助客戶、員工、學習者與觀眾，於組織旅程中創造豐富、自主的數位體驗。
Kaltura 的數位體驗平台，使組織得以建立、管理與提供視訊與豐富媒體體驗，這些體驗逐漸整合自主人工智慧（"AI"）能力，包括對話介面、工作流程自動化，以及於數位接觸點上以成果導向的參與。我們相信此視訊、豐富媒體與自主能力的結合，使組織得以超越靜態、一體適用的數位體驗，朝向更大規模、更個人化、更情境化與更互動的自主數位體驗發展。

視訊及其他形式的豐富媒體，包括互動式、數據驅動與對話式媒體，為數位互動與參與的核心，改變人們溝通、工作、學習與內容消費的方式。對組織而言，豐富媒體逐漸成為數位轉型計畫的核心，企業採用媒體驅動解決方案，以於日益廣泛的應用情境中與客戶、員工、學習者與觀眾互動。同時，生成人工智慧（"Gen AI"）的進步，使能即時自動產生高度個人化與情境相關的內容，包括視訊及其他形式的豐富媒體。我們相信豐富媒體與人工智慧的結合，正提升數位體驗的規模、速度與戰略重要性，並驅動對支援更互動、情境化與成果導向參與之平台的需求。
Kaltura 於 2006 年成立，為最早認知將視訊整合至企業作業流程中，並提供企業視訊內容管理與線上視訊發佈系統的先驅之一。隨時間推移，我們擴展平台以支援更多體驗，包括虛擬活動與網路研討會，以及雲端電視服務。今日，Kaltura 提供一雲端豐富媒體平台，協助組織於面對客戶、員工、學習者與觀眾之應用情境中，大規模建立、管理與提供豐富媒體體驗。
我們的數位體驗平台設計為三層核心架構：豐富媒體內容建立、豐富媒體內容管理，以及豐富媒體體驗。這些層次使組織得以產生與發佈即時與點播視訊及其他形式的豐富媒體，安全地管理內容、使用者、權限與元資料於企業與媒體環境中，並於廣泛的內部與外部作業流程中提供媒體豐富的體驗。此平台逐漸整合自主人工智慧驅動能力，以實現更互動、情境化與目標導向的體驗，同時維持企業等級的安全性、隱私權與治理。
隨著視訊使用在溝通、工作與學習環境中持續加速，組織正 increasingly 部署高階視訊解決方案，以進一步與其客戶、合作夥伴與員工互動。生成人工智慧（"Gen AI"）的引入進一步強化此需求，預期對我們業務產生重大影響，使能於即時自動產生高度個人化與情境相關的視訊體驗。我們相信此強大新工具將擴展視訊建立、消費與商業化的機會，並驅動對高階視訊內容管理解決方案的需求。

為支持我們的 AI 能力，於 2025 年，我們取得 eSelf AI，一家多模態 AI 實驗室，開發用以進行與實時虛擬形象互動的技術。透過此次收購，我們擴展了內容創作與體驗能力，包含 AI 產生的影片與基於虛擬形象的互動，增強我們的豐富媒體內容創作層。此外，於 2026 年 3 月，我們與 PathFactory 籤訂最終協議，取得一家提供內容旅程編排與參與分析解決方案的供應商。我們相信此收購，一旦完成，將強化我們在新興對話自動化與主導式參與解決方案市場的競爭地位，並補充我們最近取得 eSelf AI 的收購，透過增加旅程層面的編排、意圖數據、分析，以及跨更多內容類型與企業系統的整合。此交易尚未完成，且無法保證會完成或實現預期效益。
我們的營業收入主要來自軟體即服務（"SaaS"）訂閱的銷售，我們也從平台使用授權訂閱及相關專業服務中獲取收入。我們的銷售通常針對中大型企業、教育機構、科技供應商及媒體與電信業者。此外，我們正在擴展我們的市場推廣方式，以支持更廣泛的採用模式與客戶規模。我們的專業服務收入通常由新舊客戶的實施與支援服務所驅動。

於 2025 年 8 月，我們董事會批准了一項重組計畫（"2025 重組計畫"），其中包括，除其他事項外，縮減約 10% 的員工數量，並根據此調整組織結構、職責與角色。與 2025 重組計畫相關的年度總成本減縮預計為約 8.5 百萬美元。此 2025 重組計畫於 2025 年第三季完成，其重點在於重新調整公司的運作，以進一步提高效率與生產力，同時進行增強的 AI 技術整合，以因應目前總體經濟環境的不確定性，並支持公司的成長與獲利計畫。

我們將業務分為兩個應報告分部：(i) 企業、教育與科技（"EE&T"）；以及 (ii) 媒體與電信（"M&T"）。因此，我們的財務報告區分來自使用我們產品與服務以解決娛樂與 monetization 使用案例（針對其觀眾）的客戶的收入與毛利率，此部分歸屬於我們的 M&T 分部，以及來自使用我們解決方案以解決所有其他使用案例（針對其客戶、員工與學習者）的客戶的收入，歸屬於我們的 EE&T 分部。這些分部共用一個基礎平台，包含我們的 API 架構，以及統一的產品開發、運營與行政資源。
•企業、教育與科技：在 EE&T 分部，訂閱收入主要根據每名全職等效或平台使用授權基礎產生於我們所有產品，並包括來自相關專業服務的收入。此分部涵蓋使用 Kaltura 解決方案為其客戶、員工與學習者提供主導式豐富媒體體驗的客戶，例如買家培訓、員工招募、學習與教學。此分部的合約通常為 12 至 24 個月，通常以年度為基礎進行計費。

•媒體與電信：M&T 分部包括來自使用 Kaltura 提供娛樂與串流使用案例給其觀眾的客戶的收入，以及相關專業服務收入。對於使用我們電信 TVCMS 與 TV 串流應用程序的客戶，收入主要根據每名終端用戶基礎確認，而媒體客戶使用我們的線上影片平台則根據平台使用授權基礎計費。此分部的合約通常為 2 至 5 年，計費方式為每季或每年。TV 產品的實施通常需要 6 至 12 個月，初期資源需求通常高於我們其他產品。因此，從初始訂單到上線的時間較長，並伴隨較高的專業服務收入佔總收入比例。此外，此分部較多的收入來自客戶透過私有雲與內部部署授權我們的解決方案，這對我們的毛利率有影響。

headings: 與我們業務及產業相關之風險
本公司有持續虧損之歷史，可能無法達成或維持獲利能力。
本公司營運成果可能自季節至季節、年度至年度間有所波動，此情形可能對本公司普通股之交易價格產生不利影響。
本公司可能面臨因使用特定人工智慧及機器學習模型技術，以及符合人工智慧開發與使用之演進中法規架構所產生之風險。
若無法有效發展與擴展本公司行銷與銷售能力，可能影響本公司擴大客戶基礎及實現產品更廣泛市場接受度之能力。
本公司產品之銷售價格可能變動，此變動可能降低本公司營業收入與毛利率，並對本公司財務成果產生不利影響。
paragraphs: 本公司業務涉及高度風險。您應謹慎考量下列所描述的風險與不確定性，並配合本年度10-K表報表中所有其他資訊。上述任何事件的發生都可能對本公司業務、營運成果、財務狀況、流動性或前景造成損害。在這種情況下，本公司普通股的市場價格可能下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資。此外，尚有其他未被本公司目前知悉，或目前認為不重要之風險與不確定性，也可能影響本公司業務。請參閱「預測性陳述」。
本公司可能無法成功評估或緩解目前波動的經濟氣候及其對本公司業務與營運，包括客戶與供應商的直接與間接影響，或正確預測目前全球經濟不穩定的持續時間與深度，並採取正確或足夠的措施來應對，因此本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果與前景將受到不利影響。

本公司業務性質與全球佈局與營運，使本公司面臨全球與地方總體經濟與微觀經濟的影響，包括全球經濟趨勢如目前全球經濟波動、通貨膨脹上升、利率無法預測、價格上漲、各地區包括中東與東歐等地區的軍事衝突、政治變動及其對經濟市場的影響、客戶支出或預算減少導致需求下降、升價或訂閱續約減少，以及其他可能對本公司業務與營運成果產生直接或間接影響的不利因素，這些因素難以預測、監測或評估。這些發展已導致並可能繼續導致本公司預估或預期營運成果的不確定性與高波動性，可能與本公司預估與預期不同，並可能對本公司業務、營運成果與財務狀況造成不利影響。
此外，目前經濟氣候已導致，除其他因素外，銷售週期延長與價格驅動的競爭增加，包括透過投標程序的啟動，已對本公司保留現有客戶與產生續約與升價的能力造成不利影響。本公司預期這些趨勢將在近期內持續。若本公司無法保留現有客戶羣或以合理價格獲得新客戶，本公司收入可能受到衝擊甚至下降，因此本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果與前景將受到不利影響。
本公司對現有客戶需求的依賴與客戶需求變動的曝險，包括因非本公司所能控制的原因，使本公司難以評估目前業務與未來前景，並可能增加本公司無法成功之風險。
